children: Nathan’s Famous announced it will become a wholly owned subsidiary of Smithfield Foods and will cease public trading upon closing, and has supplemented its proxy statement amid litigation and stockholder demands.
Merger with Smithfield Foods will result in Nathan’s Famous becoming a wholly owned subsidiary and delisting from public markets.
Two lawsuits and fifteen demand letters allege the proxy statement is misleading and seek injunction, rescission, damages and supplemental disclosures.
Company denies the claims but voluntarily supplemented the proxy statement to moot disclosure challenges and reduce litigation uncertainty.
Jefferies’ valuation analyses disclosed implied per-share ranges versus the $102.00 per-share merger consideration used in the proxy.
